title: builtin.cond.target_in_range parameters
description: Succeeds when the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` is a current contact within `range_m` meters. Fails when the key is unset or the entity is not (or no longer) a contact. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target. The leaf only reads this key.

range_m.description: Maximum distance in meters (3D range of the contact, inclusive).
